text:
Which statement describes a transition element?
A
It can act as a catalyst and some of its compounds can also act as catalysts.
B
It forms white compounds with sulfur, oxygen, chlorine and bromine.
C
It has a low density and a piece of it will float on water.
D
It is a very poor conductor of electricity.

options.label: A
options.text: It can act as a catalyst and some of its compounds can also act as catalysts.

options.label: B
options.text: It forms white compounds with sulfur, oxygen, chlorine and bromine.

options.label: C
options.text: It has a low density and a piece of it will float on water.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a very poor conductor of electricity.
